verdict.rationale: Docs confirm an Event Webhook that posts open/click/delivery event data to a developer-controlled URL, which supports tracking what happened to emails (sendgrid-docs-7, sendgrid-docs-24). However, the evidence pack does not document a dedicated per-message Email Activity/Events query API endpoint for retrieving historical event data on demand, which is the specific 'query via API' half of the story. missing for 10: explicit Email Activity API / per-message event history query endpoint, example of querying single-message status via API, independent confirmation of API-based lookup.
